structure.unit: Activities Administered by the Department of Conservation and Recreation

law.catch_line: Disturbance of naturally occurring organisms; scientific collecting permits; penalties

text.section: It shall be unlawful to remove, kill, harm, or otherwise disturb any naturally occurring organisms within any cave, except for safety or health reasons; however, scientific collecting permits may be obtained from the Department.
Any violation of this section shall be punished as a Class 3 misdemeanor.
